The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to reach a place.

draft.emotion: relieved and satisfied, having finally arrived at the destination
notes: पहुँचना is intransitive, so it never takes ने in the past tense (e.g., मैं घर पहुँचा — I reached home). The destination usually takes no postposition.

senses.definition: To arrive at or get to a place or destination.

examples.text: हम समय पर स्टेशन पहुँच गए।
examples.translation: We reached the station on time.
examples.emotion: relieved and unhurried, glad to make it without rushing

senses.definition: To get to a particular level, stage, or state.

examples.text: बात बहुत आगे पहुँच गई है।
examples.translation: The matter has gone very far.

draftBefore.shortGloss: to reach; to arrive; to attain
draftBefore.emotion: relieved and satisfied, having finally arrived at the destination
notes: पहुँचना is an intransitive verb used to indicate arrival at a physical place or attainment of a goal.
It typically takes the postposition पर (on/at) or तक (up to) with the destination.

senses.definition: To arrive at or get to a destination or place.

examples.text: हम समय पर स्टेशन पहुँच गए।
examples.translation: We reached the station on time.
examples.emotion: relieved and unhurried, glad to make it without rushing

senses.definition: To attain a certain level, age, or state.

examples.text: वह सफलता के शिखर पर पहुँच गया।
examples.translation: He reached the peak of success.
examples.emotion: proud and triumphant, looking back at the journey

faults.why: Incorrect vowel length; the second vowel in पहुँचना is short /ʊ̃/, not long /ũː/.

faults.quote: पहुँचना is an intransitive verb used to indicate arrival at a physical
faults.why: Restates the senses without explaining what being intransitive means for Hindi grammar (no ने).

faults.quote: It typically takes the postposition पर (on/at) or तक (up to) with
faults.why: Misleading: destinations with पहुँचना usually take no postposition at all (घर पहुँचना, स्टेशन पहुँचना).
